description: This file defines the Java class 'ModifyPolicyIdResponse', which represents the response to a 'ModifyPolicyId' command in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances with different HTTP status codes, parsing from JSON, and accessing response data such as the Thing ID and Policy ID.

classes.name: ModifyPolicyIdResponse
classes.description: An immutable class representing the response to a 'ModifyPolicyId' command, including factory methods for different response statuses, JSON serialization/deserialization, and response metadata.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Factory method for a response indicating a new Policy ID has been created, with HTTP status CREATED.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Factory method for a response indicating a Policy ID has been modified, with HTTP status NO_CONTENT.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of ModifyPolicyIdResponse from a JSON string or object.
